pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). âˆ’1 = left only. +1 = right only.

spread.tooltip: Decorrelate voices (walk rate / FBM time offset).

voices.tooltip: Parallel delay lines. Each has its own Random Walk / FBM (Seed + voice index).

mode.tooltip: Delay-time modulator from SoEm Reverb. Random Walk = filtered stepped drift. FBM = fractal Brownian flutter.

delay.tooltip: Base delay. time = Delay + modulator × Depth.

depth.tooltip: Modulator throw in milliseconds. Walk/FBM is ±1 × Depth.

frequency.tooltip: Random Walk step rate, or FBM time rate.

hpfFrequency.tooltip: 6 dB/oct highpass on the ensemble wet, before Mix.

lpfFrequency.tooltip: 6 dB/oct lowpass on the ensemble wet after HP, before Mix.

seed.tooltip: Base seed. Voice i uses Seed + i.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: MIDI offset in octaves before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: MIDI offset in semitones before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Fine MIDI offset in cents before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and Inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and Inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

antialias.tooltip: Fractional sample read. Off = linear. Hermite = 4-point cubic (smoother varispeed, more CPU).

phaseOffset.tooltip: Slow reverse / forward nudge (−0.1…+0.1). No wrap. 5 s linear internal glide.

phase.tooltip: Fine scratch skip (−0.003…+0.003). 0.156 s Papoulis internal glide.

inputGain.tooltip: Drive into the limiter before detect/GR. Raise to hit Threshold harder (more pump).

threshold.tooltip: Level where gain reduction starts. Lower = more compression/pump on typical program.

ratio.tooltip: How hard GR climbs above Threshold. ~4â€“8 = firm. ~12â€“20 = heavy pump.

lookaheadEnabled.tooltip: On = delay audio so GR can fall before hits (helps pump without zero-attack chatter).

lookaheadMs.tooltip: Look-ahead delay in ms when Look-ahead is On. Part of the sound (not host-compensated).

lookaheadSamples.tooltip: Extra look-ahead in samples (added to LA Time). Hidden by default.

attack.tooltip: How fast GR engages on a hit. A few ms keeps punch while still pumping.

release.tooltip: How fast gain recovers after a hit â€” the main pump/breathe timing. Longer = slower swell back.

amplitude.tooltip: Final output trim after GR. 0â€¦1. Lower if the bus is too hot; no autogain.

q.tooltip: Bandwidth of every band. 4.32 is one-third octave, so a fader is about the level at that frequency. Lower Q is wider and neighboring cuts stack.
